_about: Input candle files shared by every strategy (read only; v2 caches them as numpy files under cache/). Other timeframes are built from the 1-minute files. Index and futures come from the Breeze Parquet store (D:/nifty_data) through tools/build_from_store.py, which writes cache/store/ (re-run it to pick up newly downloaded data). config/data.v1.json is the previous set (the files v1 reads); tests/test_parity.py uses it.
_history_from: sessions before this date are ignored (All data = from here); null = the whole files
_fz_memory_from: the FZ strategies (5-8) remember bands from this session on and resolve their backtests against the sessions from it (v1: its history_from); every FZ window is a date slice of one run from here

options._extra_dirs: more option folders in the weekly_dir layout; an expiry found in several is read from the first one with a full chain (the store's expiries are exported only once their whole window is downloaded)
